conditions.description: The seeded Layercake.silv_ref_payer_type holds exactly the three reserved rows at fixed ids plus Individual and Corporate, with byte-exact labels.
conditions.preconditions: Reads the table as deployed and seeded by the module's migration (static list, no load). Not faked, because the seed is what is under test.
conditions.expected: Exactly 5 rows: id 0 'Unknown', id -1 'Unrecognised', id -2 'Not applicable', and 'Individual' and 'Corporate' on positive ids. Labels compared as bytes. The two positive ids are exactly 1 and 2 (identity from 1), in either order.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-001 seeded payer type list holds the three reserved rows and Individual and Corporate]

conditions.description: The first usp_load_dim_payer_type run copies every silv_ref_payer_type row, reserved negative ids included, into dim_payer_type with the same id and name, and logs its outcome.
conditions.preconditions: silv_ref_payer_type, dim_payer_type and etl_run_log faked (the log with identity and defaults). Silver holds 0 Unknown, -1 Unrecognised, -2 Not applicable, 1 Individual, 2 Corporate. Empty dimension.
conditions.expected: dim_payer_type holds exactly the same 5 (id, name) pairs, names byte-exact. One etl_run_log row: 'Success', rows_inserted 5, rows_updated 0, rows_deleted 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-002 first dimension load copies all five ids and names and logs Success]

conditions.description: A second dimension load on unchanged silver changes nothing.
conditions.preconditions: Same 5 faked silver rows as TC-004-002; empty dimension; load run twice.
conditions.expected: dim_payer_type identical in every column (load_id, created_at, updated_at included) after the first and second loads, holding 0 Unknown, -1 Unrecognised, -2 Not applicable, 1 Individual, 2 Corporate. etl_run_log holds two 'Success' rows: (5, 0, 0) and (0, 0, 0).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-003 second dimension load keeps every id and changes nothing]

conditions.description: The dimension load mirrors silver as the payment method dimension load does: inserts a missing id, updates a changed name on its existing id, leaves unchanged rows untouched.
conditions.preconditions: Faked silver holds the 5 rows of TC-004-002. Faked dimension holds 0 Unknown, -1 Unrecognised, 1 Individual and 2 'Corporate scheme' (old name), each with load_id 7 and created_at and updated_at 2026-02-01 10:00:00; id -2 missing.
conditions.expected: Dimension holds exactly the 5 silver pairs, id 2 now 'Corporate' (no new row). Ids 0, -1 and 1 keep load_id 7 and created_at and updated_at 2026-02-01 10:00:00. One etl_run_log row: 'Success', 1 inserted, 1 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-004 dimension load inserts a missing id updates a changed name and leaves unchanged rows untouched]

conditions.description: A dimension name that differs from silver only in case is a changed name and is corrected, despite the case-insensitive collation.
conditions.preconditions: Faked silver: 0 'Unknown', 2 'Corporate'. Faked dimension: 0 'Unknown', 2 'CORPORATE', load_id 7.
conditions.expected: Dimension id 2 has the exact bytes of 'Corporate'; id 0 still 'Unknown'. One etl_run_log row: 'Success', 0 inserted, 1 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-005 dimension load corrects a name that differs only in case]

conditions.description: Error path (design: try/catch with XACT_ABORT, error recorded through usp_etl_log_end, re-raised): a dimension load the target rejects re-raises, logs 'Failed' and leaves the dimension unchanged.
conditions.preconditions: Runs without the tSQLt transaction. Silver, dimension and etl_run_log faked; the faked dim_payer_type gets a test-only CHECK rejecting the name 'Rejected type'. Silver: 0 Unknown, 1 Individual, 9 'Rejected type'. Dimension holds 1 'Private' (old name, so an update is pending), load_id 7.
conditions.expected: Check-constraint error 547 reaches the caller. dim_payer_type identical to before: only id 1 'Private', no id 0 or 9. Exactly one etl_run_log row, status 'Failed', non-NULL error_message.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-006 failed dimension load re-raises logs Failed and leaves the target unchanged]

conditions.description: AC-006-01 end to end: loaded from the deployed seeded list, dim_payer_type has the same (id, name) pairs as silv_ref_payer_type.
conditions.preconditions: silv_ref_payer_type not faked (the seeded list is read). dim_payer_type and etl_run_log faked; empty dimension.
conditions.expected: Dimension holds 5 rows: 0 'Unknown', -1 'Unrecognised', -2 'Not applicable', 'Individual' and 'Corporate' on positive ids, and its (id, name bytes) pairs equal silv_ref_payer_type's exactly.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-007 dimension loaded from the seeded list has the same five ids and names as the list]

conditions.description: First run of usp_load_brnz_corporate_subscription lands Subs.vwCorpSubscriptions rows 1:1 into brnz_corporate_subscription, live, with audit times, and logs its counts.
conditions.preconditions: Empty bronze (faked with defaults), empty etl_run_log. Faked source: (1000001, SCH-001, 'Alpha Surveyors LLP', 2025, Active, Active, Round 1), (1000002, SCH-001, same name, 2025, Active, Inactive, Round 2), (1000003, SCH-002, 'Beta Property Ltd', 2024, Cancelled, Active, Round 1), (1000003, SCH-002, same name, 2025, Active, Active, NULL Round).
conditions.expected: Exactly 4 rows with contact_no, scheme_no, scheme_name, sub_campaign_year, sub_status and sub_user_status equal to the source, _is_deleted 0, _deleted_at NULL, _loaded_at and _updated_at not NULL (values not asserted). One etl_run_log row: 'Success', 4 inserted, 0 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-008 first corporate subscription load lands 4 source rows 1:1 live and logs Success]

conditions.description: 'Round' is not landed (design, answers 2026-10-23): the bronze table has no Round column.
conditions.preconditions: Reads the deployed table's column metadata.
conditions.expected: Layercake.brnz_corporate_subscription exists and has no column whose name contains 'round'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-009 brnz_corporate_subscription has no Round column]

conditions.description: 'Round' plays no part: a source row that differs from bronze only in Round is not treated as a change.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds live (1000101, SCH-101, 'Kappa Valuers', 2025, Active, Active) with _loaded_at and _updated_at 2020-01-01. Source holds the same row with Round 'Round 2'.
conditions.expected: The row is unchanged, _loaded_at and _updated_at still 2020-01-01, _is_deleted 0. etl_run_log: 'Success', 0 inserted, 0 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-010 a change only in Round does not update the landed row]

conditions.description: NULL Scheme Name, Sub Status and Sub User Status land as NULL; bronze applies no default.
conditions.preconditions: Source (1000011, SCH-011, NULL, 2025, NULL, NULL, NULL) and (1000012, SCH-011, 'Gamma Estates', 2025, Active, NULL). A NULL Contact No, Scheme No or Sub Campaign Year is covered by TC-004-021 to TC-004-023 (Mike, 2026-10-26: the load fails).
conditions.expected: 1000011 has scheme_name, sub_status and sub_user_status NULL; 1000012 has 'Gamma Estates', 'Active', NULL. Both live.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-011 null scheme name and statuses land as null]

conditions.description: Bronze is a 1:1 landing with no value transformation: a blank scheme name and untrimmed or differently cased statuses land byte for byte.
conditions.preconditions: Source (1000021, SCH-021, N'', 2025, N' active ', N'ACTIVE').
conditions.expected: scheme_name is N'' (not NULL, 0 bytes); sub_status has the exact bytes of N' active '; sub_user_status the exact bytes of N'ACTIVE'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-012 blank and untrimmed mixed case values land byte for byte]

conditions.description: A second load on unchanged source (including NULL columns) changes nothing.
conditions.preconditions: Source holds 1000031/SCH-031/2025, 1000032/SCH-031/2025 with NULL name and statuses, and 1000033/SCH-032/2024. Load run twice.
conditions.expected: brnz_corporate_subscription identical in every column (_loaded_at and _updated_at included) after the first and second loads. etl_run_log holds two 'Success' rows: (3, 0, 0) and (0, 0, 0).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-013 second corporate subscription load on unchanged source changes nothing]

conditions.description: A source row whose value changed is updated in place with _updated_at refreshed; an unchanged row is untouched.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds live 1000041 and 1000042 (SCH-041, 2025, Active, Active), both _loaded_at and _updated_at 2020-01-01. Source has 1000041 with Sub User Status 'Inactive' and 1000042 unchanged.
conditions.expected: 1000041: sub_user_status 'Inactive', _loaded_at 2020-01-01, _updated_at later than 2020-01-01. 1000042: 'Active', _updated_at still 2020-01-01. Both live. etl_run_log: 'Success', 0 inserted, 1 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-014 changed corporate subscription row is updated and only it gets a new _updated_at]

conditions.description: A source value that changes only in case is a change and is landed, though the collation is case-insensitive.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds live (1000051, SCH-051, 'Iota Chartered', 2025, 'Active', 'Active') with _updated_at 2020-01-01. Source sends Sub Status 'ACTIVE'.
conditions.expected: sub_status has the exact bytes of N'ACTIVE' and _updated_at is later than 2020-01-01. etl_run_log: 'Success', 0 inserted, 1 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-015 a status change only in case is landed as a change]

conditions.description: A row no longer in the source is soft-deleted, not physically removed.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds live 1000061 and 1000062 (SCH-061, 2025). Source holds only 1000061 (unchanged).
conditions.expected: 1000061 live with _deleted_at NULL. 1000062 still present with sub_status 'Active', _is_deleted 1 and _deleted_at set. etl_run_log: 'Success', 0 inserted, 0 updated, 1 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-016 corporate subscription row gone from source is soft deleted not removed]

conditions.description: A soft-deleted row re-sent unchanged by the source is restored, not inserted a second time.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds (1000071, SCH-071, 'Mu Holdings', 2025, Active, Active) with _is_deleted 1, _deleted_at 2020-06-01. Source re-sends identical values.
conditions.expected: Exactly one row for (1000071, SCH-071, 2025) with 'Mu Holdings', 'Active', 'Active', _is_deleted 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-017 soft deleted corporate subscription row that reappears unchanged is restored]

conditions.description: Rows are matched on (contact_no, scheme_no, sub_campaign_year): a scheme-name change on an existing key updates it, while the same contact in another year or another scheme is a new row.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-033: (Contact No, Scheme No, Sub Campaign Year) is unique in the source. Bronze holds live (1000081, SCH-081, 'Zeta Old Name', 2024) with _loaded_at 2020-01-01. Source: (1000081, SCH-081, 'Zeta New Name', 2024), (1000081, SCH-081, 'Zeta New Name', 2025), (1000081, SCH-082, 'Eta Associates', 2024).
conditions.expected: Exactly 3 live rows: SCH-081/2024 'Zeta New Name' (still _loaded_at 2020-01-01, updated in place), SCH-081/2025 'Zeta New Name', SCH-082/2024 'Eta Associates'. etl_run_log: 'Success', 2 inserted, 1 updated, 0 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-018 rows are matched on contact scheme and year so a name change updates and a new year or scheme inserts]

conditions.description: Row-count check (RULE-005): after a load mixing inserts and a soft delete, live bronze rows equal the source row count, and the counts are logged.
conditions.preconditions: Bronze holds live 1000091 and 1000092 (SCH-091, 2025). Source holds 1000091 (unchanged), 1000093 and 1000094 (new).
conditions.expected: 4 rows: 1000091, 1000093, 1000094 live and 1000092 soft-deleted. Live count 3 equals the source count 3. etl_run_log: 'Success', 2 inserted, 0 updated, 1 deleted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-019 live corporate subscription rows reconcile to the source row count after inserts and a soft delete]

conditions.description: Error path: the load fails part-way through its writes on a row the target rejects; the error reaches the caller, the run is logged Failed and the target is unchanged.
conditions.preconditions: Runs without the tSQLt transaction. Bronze holds live (1000111, SCH-111, 2025, Active) and carries a test-only CHECK rejecting scheme_no 'REJECT-112'. Source has 1000111 changed to 'Cancelled' (update pending) and new (1000112, REJECT-112, 2025).
conditions.expected: Check-constraint error 547 is raised to the caller. brnz_corporate_subscription identical to before (1000111 still 'Active', no 1000112). Exactly one etl_run_log row, status 'Failed', non-NULL error_message.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-020 failed corporate subscription load re-raises logs Failed and leaves the target unchanged]

conditions.description: A source row with a NULL Contact No fails the whole load with error 515: logged Failed, re-raised, target unchanged, no row skipped (docs/answers.md 'MOD-004 NULL matching key', Mike 2026-10-26).
conditions.preconditions: Runs without the tSQLt transaction. Source, bronze and etl_run_log faked; NOT NULL is put back on the faked bronze's three key columns (same type and collation), since FakeTable makes every column nullable. Bronze holds live 1000201 and 1000202 (SCH-201, 2025, Active, Active). Source holds 1000201 changed to Sub Status 'Cancelled' (update pending), new 1000203 (insert pending), no 1000202 (soft delete pending), and (NULL, SCH-202, 'Sigma Partners', 2025).
conditions.expected: Error 515 reaches the caller. brnz_corporate_subscription identical to before in every column (1000201 still 'Active', 1000202 still live, no 1000203 and no row for the NULL-key source row). Exactly one etl_run_log row, status 'Failed', non-NULL error_message.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD004].[test TC-004-021 a source row with null Contact No fails the load with 515 and changes nothing]
